Run all five estimators (plus UNADJ) on one synthetic dataset

Source: R/run_methods.R
analyze_methods_robust.Rd

Reference-named entry point: applies UNADJ, DIRECT, COCA, IV2SLS, and PGC (matrix bridge) to each tested outcome feature and returns tidy per-feature results with a significance flag. Negative controls are summarised over the full W panel for COCA, so restricting test_features does not change its control summary. The matrix-bridge PGC uses the full W panel (or a validity-screened subset if provided).

Usage

analyze_methods_robust(
  iteration_data,
  test_features = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  debug = FALSE,
  n_cores = 1
)

Arguments

iteration_data

Dataset list from run_single_iteration() (or generate_toy_data()).

test_features

Optional integer indices of outcome features to test. Default NULL (all features).

alpha

Significance threshold for the significant flag. Default 0.05.

debug

If TRUE, message per-feature progress. Default FALSE.

n_cores

Number of parallel workers. Default 1 (sequential). Uses parallel::mclapply on Unix and a PSOCK cluster on Windows.

Value

Data frame: feature, method, beta, se, pvalue, significant.

Details

A scalar-bridge variant (fit_pgc_scalar()) is exported for standalone use but is not included in the default pipeline.

Examples

dat <- run_single_iteration(NULL, n_synthetic_samples = 100,
  n_features = 5, n_confounders = 1, seed = 1)
analyze_methods_robust(dat)
